verdict.rationale: Gaudi 3 is sold as a PCIe Gen5 accelerator card, so published board power, connector and cooling specs are a fair question and the axis applies. However, the pack contains no first-party TDP/TGP figure, power-connector requirements or cooling guidance. The only power data point is a community remark that the lower-power cards still draw about 600W, which is not published board-power documentation.

support.subject: As a gamer, I can spec a build around published board power — TDP/TGP, connector requirements, and cooling guidance for this exact card
